important_unit_conditions:
1.    Bidders are invited to bid for this unit strictly for use as a
Chinese Medical Hall
for sale of TCM-related products only.
Any proposal to operate this unit for other uses will not be considered and the bidding deposit will also be forfeited.
2.    Application for subletting, change of trade and inclusion of trades will also not be considered.
3.    The tenancy for the Premises is for a term of three (3) years with an option to renew for a further three (3) years in accordance with the provisions in the Tenancy Agreement. The renewal of the tenancy for the second three-year term shall be at the same monthly rent as the initial three-year tenancy term. To avoid doubt, the Accepted Bid will be applied during the first two (2) tenancy terms, and no rent variation or adjustment shall be permitted (except as provided in these Terms and Conditions and in the Tenancy Agreement) throughout the first 2 tenancy terms.
4.    In view that this is a newly constructed unit, the Successful Bidder will enjoy staggered rents when starting out. The monthly rent in the first year shall be calculated based on 70% of the rental bid submitted by the Successful Bidder, 90% in the second year and 100% in the third year. A Three - (3) month rent-free period is given to fit out the Premises. During this period, only the service & conservancy charges are payable.
5.    Successful bidders who commence business operations at the Premises upon expiry of the three month rent free fitting out period and within the first six months from the date the shops obtain their Temporary Occupation Permit (TOP), subject to HDB’s assessment and upon at least seven days’ advance notice of the business commencement date, may be granted an additional bonus rent free period. Details of the bonus rent free period are set out in HDB’s media release dated 4 March 2026 and more information will be indicated in the Letter of Acceptance. For financial prudence, bidders are advised to submit their bids based on the three month rent free fitting out period only.
6.    Bidders are advised to view the unit before submitting their bids. Please refer to the "Site Viewing Information" for more information.
Viewing beyond the scheduled dates shall not be accommodated.
As works are still ongoing at the development, all bidders and accompanying persons must comply with all site safety regulations and instructions from HDB representatives or the main contractor. Bidders attending the site viewing are taken to do so at their own risk. HDB shall not be liable for any injury, loss, or damage arising from the site visit.
7.    The Bidder’s bid validity period shall be six (6) months from the date of the bid closing. Bidders are strongly advised to work out their business costs and assess their business viability before submitting their bids. Bidding deposit shall be forfeited if the bidder withdraws his bid. In addition, the bidder would be debarred from participating in future auctions and tenders called for by HDB, the Government and other Statutory Boards, for a period of up to a maximum of 5 years.
8.    The successful bidder is required to carry out the necessary works and to obtain all relevant authorities' approvals (e.g. BCA, FSSD, URA) where necessary for the use of the premises at their own costs. The operation of the business shall commence only after all requirements, licenses, permission and approvals from the relevant authorities have been complied with and obtained at their own costs.
9.    Upon request by HDB, the bidder is required to submit their plans showing the proposed layout and renovation of the premises (e.g., pictures, illustrations, photographs, etc.). HDB reserves the right not to award the premises if the proposal submitted is not acceptable.
10.
Any request to upgrade the electrical load during the 1st term of tenancy i.e. first three years will not be considered.
Should there be a need to upgrade our switchroom after the 1st term of tenancy, the cost of such upgrading work shall be borne by the Tenant. Costs of electrical submain works, or electrical standard charge based on the supply required is payable by the Tenant.
11.    The Tenant is to ensure that the business operation must not give rise to complaints of nuisance and other dis-amenities. The Tenant is to maintain the premises in the opinion of HDB in a business-like and orderly manner and a clean hygienic and satisfactory condition. Failing which, HDB will not hesitate to take enforcement action and/or terminate the tenancy of the premises.
12.    Outdoor display (if any) area is strictly subject to approval.
13.    Assignment of tenancy is not allowed throughout the entire tenancy period.
14.    The sc/cc is subject to final confirmation and variation by Town Council.
15.    Please note that HDB does not provide information on any works undertaken by other authorities/ agencies and Town Council to the block or in its surrounding, as part of the unit's bidding information.
16.    All conditions in the Terms & Conditions for E-bidding shall apply unless otherwise stated. Please refer to the Place2Lease website for the Terms & Conditions for E-bidding.
Central Cooling System
17.    Where the Tenant requires air-conditioning to the Premises at any time during the Term, the Tenant shall subscribe to the specified Centralised Cooling Service (Chilled Water Supply) (“CCS”) directly from the Appointed CCS Provider. The Tenant shall not install and/or use any other air-conditioning service/system(s) in or for the Premises, without the HDB’s prior written approval.
18.    For purposes of the CCS, the Tenant shall consult and contact the Appointed CCS Provider directly on the subscription, payment and provisioning requirements for the CCS, including the applicable technical specifications and installation arrangements.
19.    the Tenant shall be responsible for arranging and complying with all applicable CCS provisioning/installation requirements, including the installation of the Chilled Water Fan Coil Unit(s) (“FCUs”) and all piping/fixtures required for the Premises, in accordance with the instructions of the Appointed CCS Provider, at the Tenant’s own costs.
20.    For the avoidance of doubt, the Tenant shall seek the prior written approval of the HDB before carrying out any installation works in or to the Premises, and shall comply with all applicable terms and conditions of this Agreement in connection with such installation works.
21.    The Tenant shall be responsible for the servicing and maintenance of all the CCS components/parts (including the FCUs and all piping/fixtures) in the Premises and to provide evidence of such servicing and maintenance to the HDB when requested by the HDB. All servicing, maintenance, repair and replacement costs of all such CCS components/parts (including the FCUs and all piping/fixtures) shall be fully borne by the Tenant.
22.    All utilities and charges incurred for usage of the CCS shall be paid by the Tenant directly to the Appointed Service Provider.
23.    The Tenant should note that the rates/tariffs for usage of the CCS as published/provided by the Appointed Service Provider are subject to revision by the Appointed Service Provider. The Tenant is advised to contact the Appointed CCS Provider for further information or if the Tenant requires any clarification on the applicable rates (including frequency of rate revisions) and/or other terms and conditions for the subscription to and/or use of the CCS.
24.    The Tenant is required to subscribe to CCS for a minimum period of 3+3 years.
